Item #1: Doctors recently diagnosed a man as having the first ever brain infection with a computer virus.
Item #2: Scientists have built the word's smallest electronic device - a transistor consisting of only 7 atoms.
Item #3: New studies find that having allergies significantly reduces the risk of acquiring certain cancers.
